rules.description: Child must be on the school roll in England
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child must be registered at a state-funded school in England to qualify for Pupil Premium

rules.description: Child must have qualified for Free School Meals at any point in the last 6 years
rules.reason_if_failed: Your child must have qualified for Free School Meals at some point to be eligible for Pupil Premium. Check if you qualify for Free School Meals first.
Pupil Premium only applies to state-funded schools in England. Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland have different funding arrangements.
Pupil Premium is only available for pupils at state-funded schools. Independent schools are not eligible.

edge_cases.description: Child is looked after by a local authority or was previously in care
edge_cases.action: Child qualifies for Pupil Premium Plus at a higher rate (£2,530). Virtual school head will manage allocation. Route to local authority.

edge_cases.description: Child's parent is in the armed forces
edge_cases.action: Child qualifies for Service Premium (£335/year). Different eligibility criteria apply. Ensure school knows about armed forces status.

edge_cases.description: Child has recently transferred between schools
edge_cases.action: FSM eligibility should transfer automatically. If not showing on new school's records, provide evidence of previous FSM qualification.

edge_cases.description: Parent unsure if child has ever qualified for FSM
edge_cases.action: Check with local authority or previous schools. FSM eligibility at any point in last 6 years counts.
